name: Vision Ventures
aliases: Vision Ventures Growth I, s. r. o.
decision_note: Bratislava pre-seed/seed VC backed by SIH; its only fund ended its investment period in December 2023 and is divesting; the latest dated deal found is a follow-on in Sloneek's EUR 3.6m late-seed round (10 Sep 2024), just before the window.

legal_entities.name: Vision Ventures Growth I, s. r. o.

evidence.quote: Vision Ventures Growth I, s. r. o. - IČO: 52656438
VC fund focused on pre-seed and seed investments in Slovakia.
We have a generalist approach and we are open to various sectors.
We invest in companies that are based and operate in Slovakia.
We usually make investments between €100 thousand and €800 thousand, maximum up to €1,6 million.
We can actively invest our funds by the end of 2023, the final closure of the fund is by the end of 2029.
The fund was designed as a fixed-term investment vehicle with an anticipated duration of 10 years; it launched operations in 2020 and finalised its investment period in December 2023.
The fund is currently its divestment phase, with the manager progressively winding down holdings and returning capital to its investors.

S novým názvem a teď už jako online systém pro řízení personální agendy zejména v malých a středních podnicích Sloneek získal investici 350 tisíc eur (9,5 milionu korun) od slovenského venture kapitálového fondu Vision Ventures výměnou za dvacetiprocentní podíl ve firmě.
The Bratislava-located Vision Ventures with €11M under management is focused on seed investments up to €800k.
The funding round was led by Purple Ventures II, with contributions from existing investors Venture to Future Fund and Vision Ventures, as Presto Ventures informed Vestbee.

analyst_notes: Exclusion E7: the manager's own site says it could actively invest until end-2023 (e7) and SIH, its LP, says the investment period ended in December 2023 and the fund is divesting (e8, e9); the fund's event date is given as 2023-12-01 because only the month is known. PitchBook's profile lists a 2026 early-stage deal in Personeo.ai (1 Mar 2026) and 2025 exits, but no quotable plain-HTML source confirms a new investment, so it is not used; it may be a follow-on from reserves and should be re-checked if a press release appears. Caplight/aggregator deals for 'Vision Ventures' in 2025-2026 (Rewaa, Deep.SA, Vennre, Madeed) belong to the Saudi firm of the same name, not this one. Capital: only the self-reported EUR 11m AUM in a 2020 Vestbee list (e11, class D); no newer figure; RÚZ shows fund filings for 2024 (Vision Ventures Growth I, ownership type 'Štátne') but the balance sheet was not extracted. Ticket: site says usually EUR 100-800k, up to 1.6m. Both entities are on the NBS register (manager registered 2019-11-11, fund 'registrovaný alternatívny investičný fond' 2019-11-11). SLOVCA full member; SIH-selected intermediary in 2019 alongside Crowdberry and Zero Gravity. Added by reviewer: Vestbee (2024-09-10, e12) reports Sloneek's EUR 3.6m late-seed round led by Purple Ventures II with existing investors Venture to Future Fund and Vision Ventures - a follow-on from reserves, 45 days before the 2024-10-25 window start, so E7 stands; latest activity date 2024-09-10.
